record.paper_title: Recent developments and open problems in linear series
record.original_question: Let S be a finite set of points in P^N. Suppose there exists m such that a(S,m)/m = (a(S,1)+N-1)/N, where a(S,m) is the least degree of a divisor vanishing to order at least m on S. Must S then either lie in a hyperplane or be a star configuration? More generally, if the Waldschmidt constant satisfies e(S) = (a(S,1)+N-1)/N, must the same conclusion hold?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.1.3 If for some m we have a(S, m)/m = (a(S, 1) + N - 1)/N is it true that S is either contained in a hyperplane or is a star configuration? What if e(S) = (a(S, 1) + N - 1)/N?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S = \{P_1, \dots, P_s\}$ be a finite set of distinct points in projective space $\mathbb{P}^N$ over an algebraically closed field, where $N \geq 2$. For a positive integer $m$, define
$$\alpha(S,m) = \min\{\deg F : F \in k[x_0,\dots,x_N] \text{ is a nonzero homogeneous form vanishing to order} \geq m \text{ at every } P_i\}.$$
In particular $\alpha(S,1) = \alpha(S)$ is the least degree of a hypersurface through $S$. The Waldschmidt constant of $S$ is defined as
$$\widehat{\alpha}(S) = \lim_{m \to \infty} \frac{\alpha(S,m)}{m} = \inf_{m \geq 1} \frac{\alpha(S,m)}{m}.$$
A star configuration of points in $\mathbb{P}^N$ is the set of all $\binom{d}{N}$ pairwise intersections of $N$ of $d$ given hyperplanes in $\mathbb{P}^N$ that meet properly (i.e., no $N+1$ of the hyperplanes share a common point and any $N$ meet in exactly one point), for some $d \geq N$.

It is known that
$$\frac{\alpha(S,m)}{m} \geq \widehat{\alpha}(S) \geq \frac{\alpha(S) + N - 1}{N}.$$

Question: 

(a) Suppose there exists a positive integer $m$ such that
$$\frac{\alpha(S,m)}{m} = \frac{\alpha(S) + N - 1}{N}.$$
Must $S$ either be contained in a hyperplane of $\mathbb{P}^N$, or be a star configuration?

(b) Suppose instead that
$$\widehat{\alpha}(S) = \frac{\alpha(S) + N - 1}{N}.$$
Must the same conclusion hold; that is, is $S$ necessarily contained in a hyperplane or a star configuration?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this characterization-of-equality problem was located. Recent work (e.g., on Chudnovsky-type bounds, symbolic defects of star configurations, and the containment problem) continues to study related lower bounds and equality cases without settling the conjectured dichotomy. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Star configurations in P^n (Geramita, Harbourne, Migliore)
status_evidence.snippet: A star configuration of degree d consists of all intersection points of d ≥ N general hyperplanes in P^N.
status_evidence.claim: Star configurations are extremal examples for several inequalities involving alpha and Waldschmidt-type invariants.

status_evidence.title: On the containment problem (Szemberg–Szpond)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of containment problem, resurgence, Waldschmidt constants and star configurations, with open problems still active.
status_evidence.claim: Equality characterizations in Chudnovsky-type lower bounds remain part of ongoing research.

status_evidence.title: The symbolic defect and the Waldschmidt constant of a general star configuration in P^n
status_evidence.snippet: Computes Waldschmidt constants of star configurations and discusses Chudnovsky-type conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work computes invariants for star configurations but does not establish the converse characterization.
